pages.title: Make It Yours
pages.text: Change a placed Counter top using supported wood or stone.

pages.title: Make It Yours
pages.text: Make furniture fit your home; shelves and cushions immediately offer two more furnishing options.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Furniture is configurable: a Hammer changes supported shapes, cushion/sheet changes a fancy bed, and a plate displays an inserted item. Start by committing a real countertop material change.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click a counter with supported wood or stone. Replace the counter surface material.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Apply a cushion or sheet to a compatible bed. Change pillow color or bedsheets.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click supported furniture with the Hammer; some variants use sneak-right-click. Change furniture shape or appearance.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click a plate with an item. Display that item on the plate.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Existing BBB Hammer invokes Handcrafted native furniture-change contract; target the supported detail rather than creating another furniture system.
